ui_ueber: Overview: when the coupling tears off
ui_intro: A short film without sound: everything is shown as text in the picture. You can pause at any time or choose a chapter.
k1_p1: The rig drives with a trailer.
k1_p2: Suddenly the coupling tears off. The air lines tear off with it.
k1_p3: The red line is open: the trailer brakes by itself.
k1_p4: The tractor unit keeps its brakes and stays steerable.
k2_p1: When the lines tear off, the red line loses its pressure.
k2_p2: The trailer brake valve brakes the trailer with the air from its reservoir.
k2_p3: A check valve keeps the air in the trailer's reservoir.
k2_p4: The brake circuits of the tractor unit stay filled thanks to protection valves.
k2_p5: How long the braking effect lasts depends on the air supply in the trailer.
k3_sub: The brake line is gone, red holds.
k3_p1: If only the yellow line tears off, you notice nothing while driving.
k3_p2: Only when braking is the counter-pressure missing.
k3_p3: The tractor unit then vents the red line and the trailer brakes.
k3_p4: That is why you always check the trailer brake after coupling.
k4_merk: Red tears off: the trailer brakes by itself at once. Only yellow tears off: only when braking. The tractor unit can still brake.
